local_changes: Only framework imports in the four model/loss files are redirected to compat.py; unused timm registration/config and unused head imports removed. Model class bodies and loss algorithms are unchanged.

compat.py replaces old timm/MMCV/MMseg infrastructure with torch-only services: per-sample DropPath, torch trunc_normal_, ConvModule (Conv2d, native SyncBatchNorm, ReLU), resize, initialization, registries and loss construction.
Legacy fp16 decorators are identities because MoonSeg owns AMP. Standalone native SyncBatchNorm uses torch batch_norm; distributed training retains SyncBatchNorm.
MoonSeg wrapper freezes only the unused inherited conv_seg branch; all tensors are preserved in checkpoints, all executed encoder/head parameters train.
No external timm, mmcv, mmseg, or transformers implementation is imported.

compatibility_reference_sources.drop_path: timm 0.3.2 DropPath per-sample keep_prob + rand, floor, divide by keep_prob; torch.nn.init.trunc_normal_ used for legacy timm truncated-normal initialization
